highlights: Architected the One OSS telecom KPI platform at MTN Irancell. It processes 15 million measurement rows per hour and was designed for 10 billion records per month.
Built Kafka and ClickHouse ingestion and Airflow workflows for repeatable KPI recalculation.
Designed an ETL system for Atoll network data and a high-performance GraphQL API for network metadata.

Cut KPI API response time from 40 minutes to 840 ms in an end-to-end benchmark covering roughly 4,000 sites. Profiling pointed to repeated scans in the Go response builder, which we replaced with single-pass grouping.
Worked on a KPI platform that publishes versioned Parquet snapshots for partners, sends Kafka notifications when new versions are ready, and serves dashboards through a ClickHouse query API.

articles.title: How we cut KPI response time from 49 seconds to 840 ms
How we distribute KPIs through Parquet, Kafka, and a query API
